fields.name: num_inference_steps
fields.title: Num Inference Steps
fields.description: The number of inference steps to perform.

fields.name: image_size
fields.title: Image Size
fields.description: The size of the generated image.

fields.name: seed
fields.title: Seed
fields.description:
The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model
        will output the same image every time.

fields.name: guidance_scale
fields.title: Guidance scale (CFG)
fields.description:
The CFG (Classifier Free Guidance) scale is a measure of how close you want
        the model to stick to your prompt when looking for a related image to show you.

fields.name: output_format
fields.title: Output Format
fields.description: The format of the generated image.

fields.name: acceleration
fields.title: Acceleration
fields.description: The speed of the generation. The higher the speed, the faster the generation.
